states.name: Galahad
states.title: The Silent Knight of Camelot
states.description: A young knight who is a descendant of a Knight of the Round Table. For her, the king's royal decree takes precedence over anything else. To her, having been entrusted with this decree is a sacred vow made to the king—and the very purpose of her life. Determined to accomplish this royal mission passed down from her ancestors, she presses onward without hesitation.

states.name: Galahad
states.title: The Silent Knight of Camelot
states.description: Every morning at dawn, Galahad polishes her helm and weapon. Whether a sandstorm rages around her or winter's cold bites deep into her bones, she never neglects this ritual. "A knight must always be prepared for the moment her duty calls," she murmurs—though the king who would've called upon her is no more.

states.name: Galahad
states.title: The Silent Knight of Camelot
states.description: At the edge of the desert, she met a former queen who has closed off her heart and sworn never to trust anyone again. A knight who has lost the king she was meant to protect, and a queen who has lost the people she was meant to believe in—their journey together gradually gave rise to a new vow, one born not of any duty or decree, but of her own will.
